## Notes & Examples

### ECS Architecture Pattern

The Entity Component System (ECS) separates data (Components) from behavior (Systems). Entities are lightweight IDs that group components. Systems query entities by component type and process them in bulk, enabling cache-friendly iteration and parallel execution.

**Example: Creating and querying entities**
```js
import { World } from 'engine/ecs/World.js';
import { Component } from 'engine/ecs/Component.js';
import { System } from 'engine/ecs/System.js';

// Define component types
class Position extends Component { x = 0; y = 0; z = 0; }
class Velocity extends Component { x = 0; y = 0; z = 0; }

// Create world and entities
const world = new World();
const player = world.createEntity();
player.add(new Position(0, 0, 0));
player.add(new Velocity(1, 0, 0));

// Movement system queries Position + Velocity
class MovementSystem extends System {
  query = [Position, Velocity];
  
  update(entities, dt) {
    for (const entity of entities) {
      const pos = entity.get(Position);
      const vel = entity.get(Velocity);
      pos.x += vel.x * dt;
      pos.y += vel.y * dt;
      pos.z += vel.z * dt;
    }
  }
}

world.addSystem(new MovementSystem());
world.update(0.016);  // Simulate 16ms frame
```

**See also:** [ECS v2](/engine/ecs.md) · [Engine Architecture](/engine/architecture.md)

### ECS Architecture Pattern

The Entity Component System (ECS) separates data (Components) from behavior (Systems). Entities are lightweight IDs that group components. Systems query entities by component type and process them in bulk, enabling cache-friendly iteration and parallel execution.

**Example: Creating and querying entities**
```js
import { World } from 'engine/ecs/World.js';
import { Component } from 'engine/ecs/Component.js';
import { System } from 'engine/ecs/System.js';

// Define component types
class Position extends Component { x = 0; y = 0; z = 0; }
class Velocity extends Component { x = 0; y = 0; z = 0; }
class Health extends Component { current = 100; max = 100; }

// Create world and entities
const world = new World();
const player = world.createEntity();
player.add(new Position(0, 0, 0));
player.add(new Velocity(1, 0, 0));
player.add(new Health(100, 100));
```

**Advanced: Complex queries**
```js
// Query entities with Position AND Velocity but NOT Static
class MovementSystem extends System {
  query = [Position, Velocity];
  exclude = ['Static'];  // Skip immovable objects
  
  update(entities, dt) {
    for (const entity of entities) {
      const pos = entity.get(Position);
      const vel = entity.get(Velocity);
      pos.x += vel.x * dt;
      pos.y += vel.y * dt;
      pos.z += vel.z * dt;
    }
  }
}

// Query with OR conditions
const damaged = world.query([Health], {
  filter: (e) => e.get(Health).current < e.get(Health).max
});
```

**Advanced: System groups and ordering**
```js
// Systems run in group order, within group by priority
world.addSystem(new InputSystem(), { group: 'input', priority: 0 });
world.addSystem(new AISystem(), { group: 'ai', priority: 0 });
world.addSystem(new MovementSystem(), { group: 'physics', priority: 0 });
world.addSystem(new CollisionSystem(), { group: 'physics', priority: 1 });
world.addSystem(new RenderSystem(), { group: 'render', priority: 0 });

// Groups run: input → ai → physics → render
world.update(0.016);
```

**Advanced: Component events**
```js
// React to component add/remove
world.onComponentAdded(Health, (entity, health) => {
  console.log('Entity', entity.id, 'health set to', health.max);
});

world.onComponentRemoved(Health, (entity) => {
  console.log('Entity', entity.id, 'died (health removed)');
});
```

**Gotchas:**
- **Adding components during iteration**: Safe, but new entities won't appear until next frame.
- **Removing entities**: Mark for deletion, processed at end of frame to avoid iterator invalidation.
- **Singleton components**: Use `world.getResource(Singleton)` for global state like Time, Input.

**See also:** [ECS v2](/engine/ecs.md) · [Engine Architecture](/engine/architecture.md)
